Name: Better Fertilizer
Author: ForgedBrass
Description: Ever struggle to see which tile you already placed Speed-Gro on? Worry no longer! With Better Fertilizer, it is much easier to tell which tiles still need to be hit. This mod changes the appearance of Basic Fertilizer, Quality Fertilizer, Speed-Gro, Delux Speed-Gro, Quality Retaining Soil, and Basic Retaining Soil

Manifest.Name: Better Fertilizer
Manifest.Description: Changes the apperance of fertilizer to make it easier to see.
